name: toonflow
description: Laywork 是一款开源 AI 创作工具，用无限画布和 Agent 助手组织文字、图片、视频、音频与自定义节点。
author: HBAI-Ltd <ltlctools@outlook.com>

scripts.dev: TOONFLOW_HOST=desktop bun run dev:server & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.dev:plugins: bun -e "import { Glob } from 'bun'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; const files = ['tools','nodes','ext'].flatMap(k => [...new Glob('packages/' + k + '/*/package.json').scanSync('.')]); for (const file of files) { const run = Bun.spawnSync(['bun','run','build'], { cwd: resolve(file,'..'), env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'dev' }, stdio: ['inherit','inherit','inherit'] }); if (run.exitCode) process.exit(run.exitCode); }"
scripts.build: bun run build:tools && bun run build:ext && bun run --filter '@toonflow/web' --filter '@toonflow/server' build
scripts.build:nodes: bun -e "import { rmSync } from '@toonflow/file'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; import { Glob } from 'bun'; rmSync(resolve('build/nodes'), { recursive: true, force: true }); for (const file of new Glob('packages/nodes/*/package.json').scanSync('.')) { const dir = resolve(file, '..'); const run = Bun.spawnSync(['bun', 'run', 'build'], { cwd: dir, env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'production' }, stdio: ['inherit', 'inherit', 'inherit'] }); if (run.exitCode) process.exit(run.exitCode); }"
scripts.build:ext: bun -e "import { rmSync } from '@toonflow/file'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; import { Glob } from 'bun'; rmSync(resolve('build/ext'), { recursive: true, force: true }); for (const file of new Glob('packages/ext/*/package.json').scanSync('.')) { const dir = resolve(file, '..'); const run = Bun.spawnSync(['bun', 'run', 'build'], { cwd: dir, env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'production' }, stdio: ['inherit', 'inherit', 'inherit'] }); if (run.exitCode) process.exit(run.exitCode); }"
scripts.build:tools: bun -e "import { rmSync } from '@toonflow/file'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; import { Glob } from 'bun'; rmSync(resolve('build/tools'), { recursive: true, force: true }); for (const file of new Glob('packages/tools/*/package.json').scanSync('.')) { const dir = resolve(file, '..'); const run = Bun.spawnSync(['bun', 'run', 'build'], { cwd: dir, env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'production' }, stdio: ['inherit', 'inherit', 'inherit'] }); if (run.exitCode) process.exit(run.exitCode); }"
